source.notes: Official CISCE item bank 'ISC Competency Focused Practice Questions, Computer Science, Class - XI' (cover prints 'cLASS - XI'; page headers 'ISC-Class XI'; 'First edition: August 2026'; preface dated 31st August 2026; uploaded to cisce.org in 2026/09). It is a question bank, not an examination paper: examYear is null and no maximum marks or duration are printed. 43 PDF pages: questions on printed pages 1-26 (PDF pages 6-31; PDF page = printed page + 5), Answer Key on printed pages 27-37 (PDF pages 32-42). 75 questions in six sections with marks in each section header: I MCQs (Q1-20, 1 mark), II Assertion-Reason (Q21-25, 1 mark), III Very Short Answer (Q26-50, 1 mark), IV Short Answer (Q51-65, 2 marks), V Long Answer (Q66-70, 5 marks), VI Very Long Answer (Q71-75, 10 marks); marksSource is SECTION_INSTRUCTIONS and the 155-mark total is just the sum of the bank. Multi-part questions are kept as one entry. Each question prints a topic tag in square brackets and a cognitive domain in parentheses (recorded as cognitiveLevel). pdftotext -layout drops overlapping lines on several pages, so text was taken from pdfplumber and checked against page renders. Code is reproduced line by line with its printed characters (including typographic quotes, primes and spacing slips such as 'Class Ex', 'i< =5', 's1= = s2', which are not corrected); indentation is approximated from the layout because the PDF sets code in a proportional font. officialAnswer comes from the bank's Answer Key ('neither limiting nor exhaustive'), copied as printed and never extended; answer programs longer than 1200 characters are trimmed with '…'. The copyright page reserves all rights; reproduction here is for study with attribution and a link to the original.

questions.text:
A mobile application allows users to view and place virtual furniture within their actual surroundings using a smartphone camera. In contrast, virtual property walkthroughs enable users to explore a completely computer-generated environment as if they were physically present there.
The first is an application of Augmented Reality (AR), whereas the latter is an application of Virtual Reality (VR).

officialAnswer.text:
AR uses a real-world setting while VR is completely virtual.
AR can be accessed with a smartphone but VR requires a headset device.
AR users can control their presence in the real world; VR users are controlled by the system.

• The Senior Doctor agrees and the Ethics Officer disagrees,
OR
• The Specialist agrees while the Senior Doctor disagrees,
OR

The Inputs are:
INPUTS
D | Denotes the Senior Doctor’s vote
S | Denotes the Specialist’s vote
E | Denotes the Ethics Officer’s vote
[In all the above cases, 1 indicates agrees and 0 indicates disagrees]

questions.text:
Write a program in Python to display all Mersenne numbers Mₙ , where n should range from 2 to 10, i.e. 2<=n<=10. Along with the generated Mersenne numbers display their status as Mersenne Prime or Mersenne Composite.
A Mersenne number is a positive integer that is one less than a power of two, i.e. Mₙ=2ⁿ-1, where n is an integer.
E.g. M₂=2²-1= 3
M₃=2³-1= 7
M₄=2⁴-1 = 15
If the generated Mersenne number is a prime number, then it is called a Mersenne prime. E.g. 7
If the generated Mersenne number is a composite number, then it is called a Mersenne composite. E.g. 15
